name: Accordion – Add Horizontal / Vertical Accordion in WP
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
B Accordion is a Gutenberg block plugin that allows you to create responsive and customizable accordion sections in WordPress. It is ideal for FAQs, toggle content, feature lists, timelines, and organized page sections—all without writing any code.

Accordion | Pricing | Support | Demos

Built specifically for the WordPress block editor, the plugin focuses on ease of use, performance, and flexibility. You can add unlimited accordion blocks, control layouts and styles, and ensure a smooth user experience across all devices.

Key Features – Free Version

  • Gutenberg Block Support: A dedicated accordion block for the WordPress block editor that lets you add and manage accordion content visually.

  • 3 Free Accordion Themes: Includes three clean and minimalist themes suitable for FAQ sections, documentation, and general content organization.

  • Fully Responsive Design: Ensures accordion layouts adapt smoothly to desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

  • **Vertical and Horizontal Layouts: Choose how accordion panels are displayed to better match your page structure and content flow.

  • Multiple Style Variations: Predefined layout and design variations to help you create accordion sections quickly.

  • Dynamic Content Support: Add text, images, and links inside accordion items to create rich and flexible content areas.

  • Custom Styling Options: Basic controls for colors, backgrounds, and font sizes to match your website’s design.

  • Smooth Transition Animations: Clean open and close animations that improve readability and user experience.

  • Unlimited Accordions: Create and use as many accordion blocks as needed across posts and pages.

  • Icon Support for Toggles: Select built-in icons or upload custom icons for expand and collapse actions.

  • Fast and Lightweight: Optimized for performance to ensure fast loading and minimal impact on site speed.

  • No Coding Required: All settings are managed from the block sidebar, making it beginner-friendly.

B Accordion Pro – Unlock Advanced Features

The Pro version extends the free functionality with advanced layouts and premium accordion designs.

Pro Features Include:

  • 5+ Premium Accordion Themes: Additional professionally designed themes with modern and creative layouts.

  • Progress Timeline Theme: A visual timeline layout for displaying step-by-step processes or progress-based content.

  • Geometric Bold Theme: A modern accordion design featuring sharp edges, bold borders, and interactive hover effects.

  • Vertical Timeline Theme: Designed for presenting chronological content such as milestones or project phases.

  • History Timeline Theme: A date-focused layout ideal for showcasing historical events or company timelines.

  • Tabbed Accordion Theme: A hybrid layout that combines tabs and accordions to organize large or complex content sections.

  • Priority Technical Support: Faster access to developer support for assistance, fixes, and updates.

How to Use Accordion – Step-by-Step Guide

Getting started with B Accordion is quick and easy!

Step-by-Step Instructions

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Open the page or post into WordPress block editor.
  3. Add the Accordion block from the Widgets block category.
  4. Configure content and styles from the block settings panel.
  5. Save or publish your page.

Enjoy your beautifully designed collapsible content!

sections.installation:
From Gutenberg Editor:

  1. Go to the WordPress Block/Gutenberg Editor
  2. Search For ** Accordion**
  3. Click on the Accordion to add the block

Download & Upload:

  1. Download the ** B Accordion** plugin (.zip file)
  2. In your admin area, go to the Plugins menu and click on Add New
  3. Click on Upload Plugin and choose the b-accordion.zip file and click on Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin and Enjoy!

Manually:

  1. Download and upload the B Accordion plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
sections.faq:
Is Accordion Block free?

Yes, Accordion Block is a free Gutenberg block plugin.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, it will work with any standard WordPress theme.

Can I change block settings?

Yes, you can change block settings from the Gutenberg block editor’s right sidebar.

How many times can I reuse a block?

There’s no limit. You can reuse the block unlimited times across your website—on pages, posts, or anywhere the block editor is available.

Where can I get support?

You can post your questions on the support forum here
